title: "Resources"
order: 2
---

External links for this lesson. All checked to load from a plain request as of the date this
page was written. (Note: eCFR's own site — ecfr.gov — blocks automated/proxied traffic with a
bot check in this repo's build environment, even though a human browser reaches it fine; the
regulation text quoted in this lesson comes from eCFR's public Versioner API instead, and the
links below use verified-loading mirrors of the same official text.)

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 630.10, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/630.10)**
  — Cornell Law School's Legal Information Institute mirror of the general donor eligibility
  requirements quoted throughout this lesson. Use this to check the current text, since
  regulations get amended and the copy in this repo's `sources/` folder is a dated snapshot.

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR 630.40, current text](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/630.40)**
  — the deferred-donor notification requirements this lesson quotes for the 8-week notification
  clock. Same use case: check for amendments against the dated snapshot in `sources/`.

- **[Cornell LII: Title 21, Part 630 browse index](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/part-630)**
  — the full donor-eligibility part this lesson's two sections sit inside, including the
  definitions in 630.3 (donor, eligibility, suitability) and the requirements specific to
  apheresis and Source Plasma donors in 630.15, which this director-level lesson doesn't cover
  but which your Quality Analyst will cite directly.

- **[GovInfo: Code of Federal Regulations](https://www.govinfo.gov/app/collection/cfr)** — the
  U.S. Government Publishing Office's official, legally authoritative annual CFR archive. Use
  this for the official, dated, legally citable version of a specific year's text — for example,
  to confirm exactly what 630.10 said on the date of a past inspection or donor complaint.
